# Nour Adhkar / اذکار نور
Daily Islamic prayers (adhkar) for Sunni Muslims — Arabic text, Persian/Arabic/Sorani translation, audio, offline, ad-free.

## Persian lecture library
- https://adhkar.ir/lectures — currently published audio lectures by Sheikh Ziaei, with listenable archive and individual pages.
- https://adhkar.ir/lectures/ziaei — Sheikh Ziaei lecture index.

## Key URLs
- https://adhkar.ir/ — Homepage (app features, download links)
- https://adhkar.ir/adhkar/sobhgahi — Morning adhkar
- https://adhkar.ir/adhkar/shamgahi — Evening adhkar
- https://adhkar.ir/adhkar/istikhara — Istikhara prayer
- https://adhkar.ir/adhkar/ramadan — Ramadan adhkar
- https://adhkar.ir/blog — Articles (20+ posts on virtues, methods, specific duas)
- https://adhkar.ir/app — Android app download (Cafe Bazaar, Myket, direct APK)
- https://adhkar.ir/about — About & privacy

## Entities
- Organization: Nour Adhkar (ادریس رنجبر, developer)
- SoftwareApplication: Nour Adhkar Android App
- WebSite: adhkar.ir
- Blog: Articles on Islamic supplications
